pipeline.name: self_best_contrast
pipeline.rule: Synchronize good/weak comparable reps and find earliest meaningful divergence.

pipeline.name: causal_hypotheses
pipeline.rule: Label ROOT_CAUSE / CONTRIBUTOR / COMPENSATION / SYMPTOM; preserve contradictory evidence.

pipeline.name: coaching_compilation
pipeline.rule: 1 primary insight, 1-3 strengths, <=2 secondary insights; one active cue.

pipeline.name: claim_traceability_qa
pipeline.rule: Every public claim must resolve to evidence IDs and a comparison basis; unsupported claims are removed.

causal_priority.note: This is a coaching heuristic, not a claim that every earlier event causes every later event.

minimum_evidence.single_stroke: describe mechanics of this rep only; no habit language and no population benchmark unless explicitly contextualized

strength_selection.language: Specific and earned: name exactly what the player is doing well and why it helps.

correction_selection.safety_gate: Do not prescribe through pain; do not diagnose injury.
correction_selection.stability_rule: Do not churn the primary correction between sessions unless evidence materially changes.
